name: refract
description: A portable engineering brain for AI coding agents. Installs the 15 global orchestration commands (/do, /setup-project, /scaffold-project, /refine-prompt, /roadmap, /audit, /optimize, /align, /refactor, /polish, /unify-surfaces, /task, /delegate, /setup-project-adapters, /setup-project-health) and ships the framework source — 23 role-based packs, 35 technical domains, 15 business domains, 12 tool adapters, 109 scripts — that /setup-project installs per project.
